evidence.evidence_text: We first design Conditional Step-level Self-refinement, a fine-grained sequential scaling method guided by process verification.
On top of its effectiveness, we further combine it with other classical parallel scaling methods at the step level, to introduce a novel inference paradigm called Hybrid Test-Time Scaling.
Test-Time Scaling (TTS) is a promising approach to progressively elicit the model’s intelligence during inference.
